user.title: Connect to a Hikvision access terminal
user.description: Use a dedicated low-privilege account if the device supports one; some models only have `admin`. The device locks accounts after a few failed logins, so double-check the password.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the terminal.
data_description.verify_ssl: These devices ship self-signed certificates; enable only if you installed a trusted one.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The terminal at {host} rejected the stored credentials.

error.unexpected_response: The device answered, but not like a Hikvision ISAPI terminal.

abort.wrong_device: These credentials belong to a different device.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to the Hikvision terminal.

invalid_auth.message: The Hikvision terminal rejected the credentials.

unexpected_response.message: The Hikvision terminal returned an unexpected response.

door_permission_denied.message: The configured account is not allowed to open the door.

stream_permission_denied.title: Hikvision account cannot read events
stream_permission_denied.description: The account used for {title} can log in but was refused access to the event stream (`/ISAPI/Event/notification/alertStream`). Grant it event/notification permission on the device, then reload the integration.
